'''2020 TMW Pods Chris Kelly DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Kelly]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Kelly]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open NMNPND Kelly DS 2020 Texas.txt |Download]]
